$schema-note: Project-brain repo's own convention rules. Each rule blocks Edit/Write/MultiEdit at the PreToolUse hook and is also checked by `npm run brain:lint-conventions -- --scan` in pre-commit/CI. Cite the ADR or module doc that owns each rule in the message.

rules.name: no-duplicate-cli-helpers
rules.message: Import takeFlag/takeOption/peekOption/splitEnv from './common.mjs' — do not redefine them. See CONTRIBUTING.md 'no duplicate helpers'.

rules.name: no-bare-fs-on-active-state
rules.message: active_state.md must be mutated via withStateLock helpers in active-state.mjs (addWorkstream/addLease/...). See decisions/0005-active-state-exclusive-lock.md.

rules.name: no-silent-shell-failures-in-setup
rules.message: Setup shell scripts must propagate non-zero exits so half-initialized state is visible. See the post-audit hardening commit (P3.5).

rules.name: no-relative-skill-paths
rules.message: Build paths from ROOT / SKILL_DIR in common.mjs — no '../../skills/project-brain' relative paths.

rules.name: aggregate-summaries-via-helper
rules.message: Aggregate (module/feature/project/package/cluster) embeddingText must go through buildAggregateSummaryTexts in aggregate.mjs to honor the MiniLM context cap. See decisions/0008-aggregate-vector-records.md.

rules.name: hook-errors-on-stderr
rules.message: Hook scripts must log failures to process.stderr before exiting — never swallow with empty catch. See decisions/0005 + the brain-session-digest P1.5 commit.

rules.name: no-duplicate-common-helpers
rules.message: This helper already exists in common.mjs — import it instead of redefining (ponytail rung 4: don't rewrite what's installed). See CONTRIBUTING.md 'no duplicate helpers'.
